title: Clarinet versus saxophone technique
summary: Howard never studied either, calls the saxophone easy and the clarinet demanding, and recalls practicing his fingers in a mirror.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Reeds, mouthpieces and horns: the reed player's gear

blocks.x: Didn't you ever study clarinets? No.

Saxes was just like a throwover when they picked it up. It's nothing. Easy to play? Sure. Clarinets and so- Got a key and just touch it and press it down. Clarinets you got to close those holes, you know, rings. And if you just leave this little air slip out, that's something going to start to squeaking. Everything's wrong. I used to stand in the mirror and wash my fingers. Oh yeah?
Sure. How did you learn how to blow correctly?
